Insulation Resistance (Megger) Test Report 17 checkpoints across 5 sections.Before energization of any electrical circuit; pre-commissioning requirement per IS 732 Download ExcelDownload PDF **17** Checkpoints **5** Sections Per circuit installation, mandatory before handover QC Engineer, Electrical Supervisor [IS 732:2015](https://infralens.in/code/IS-732-1989) [IS 694:2010](https://infralens.in/code/IS-694-1990) Related [📐IS 732](https://infralens.in/code/IS-732) [✏️Residential Connected Load…](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/residential-connected-load-per-sqft) [📘Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-cover) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧RCC design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. TEST PROCEDURE & SETUP | | A1 | Circuit isolated and disconnected from supply before testing; main switch in OFF position
Acceptance: Circuit isolated, supply switch OFF, confirmation obtained from site engineer | Cl. 11.1.1 — Safety precaution | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Megohmmeter (megger) is calibrated; test voltage is 500 V DC for LV circuits (≤1000 V)
Acceptance: Megger rated 500 V DC for LV, calibration certificate dated within 12 months | Cl. 11.1.2 — Equipment specification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | All load equipment (luminaires, sockets, switches) disconnected or isolated during testing
Acceptance: All load equipment isolated, connections verified OFF, MCBs in OFF position | Cl. 11.1.3 — Load isolation | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Test is performed in dry conditions; equipment is at ambient temperature (±5°C variation acceptable)
Acceptance: Ambient temperature recorded, no active heating/cooling, humidity ≤ 95% RH | Cl. 11.1.4 — Environmental conditions | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. INSULATION RESISTANCE TESTING | | B1 | Phase-to-Neutral insulation resistance measured; reading ≥ 1.0 MΩ minimum
Acceptance: Reading ≥ 1.0 MΩ at 500 V DC, stable reading taken after 1 minute, recorded in report | Cl. 11.1.5 — Phase-neutral insulation | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Phase-to-Earth insulation resistance measured; reading ≥ 1.0 MΩ minimum
Acceptance: Reading ≥ 1.0 MΩ at 500 V DC, stable reading after 1 minute, recorded in report | Cl. 11.1.6 — Phase-earth insulation | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Neutral-to-Earth insulation resistance measured; reading ≥ 1.0 MΩ minimum
Acceptance: Reading ≥ 1.0 MΩ at 500 V DC, stable reading after 1 minute, recorded in report | Cl. 11.1.7 — Neutral-earth insulation | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Three-phase system: Phase A-to-Phase B, Phase B-to-Phase C, Phase C-to-Phase A insulation tested; all ≥ 1.0 MΩ
Acceptance: All inter-phase readings ≥ 1.0 MΩ, stable after 1 minute, recorded individually for each phase pair | Cl. 11.1.8 — Inter-phase insulation | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B5 | If insulation reading is marginal (0.5-1.0 MΩ), circuit is left isolated and rechecked after 24 hours (moisture drying)
Acceptance: Marginal readings (0.5-1.0 MΩ) isolated, dried with heat if necessary, re-tested after 24 hours or after heating | Cl. 11.1.9 — Low resistance procedure | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA & REMEDIAL ACTION | | C1 | All readings ≥ 1.0 MΩ: Circuit APPROVED for energization; test certificate signed
Acceptance: All insulation readings ≥ 1.0 MΩ, circuit approved, test report signed and filed | Cl. 11.2.1 — Acceptance condition | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Reading < 0.5 MΩ: Circuit REJECTED; NCR raised, cable tested for fault location
Acceptance: If < 0.5 MΩ: Circuit rejected, NCR raised, fault location testing performed, cable replaced if defect confirmed | Cl. 11.2.2 — Rejection condition | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Faulty section identified (if possible) and isolated; replacement cable laid and re-tested before approval
Acceptance: Faulty cable section cut out, replacement cable installed, insulation re-tested and confirmed ≥ 1.0 MΩ | Cl. 11.2.3 — Repair procedure | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | For marginal readings after drying, circuit may be approved WITH CONDITIONS pending final energization test
Acceptance: After 24 h drying, reading ≥ 0.5 MΩ: approved with condition to monitor during first 48 hours of operation | Cl. 11.2.4 — Conditional approval | OK
NC
NA
